global_rules.cache_states: The only application cache state is the vismap npz on W3 and W3b (first_use = --vis-cache at a fresh path, build + save; repeated_use = --vis-cache $STAGE/cache/<case>.npz from an untimed warm-up with equal metadata, load; noflag = built in memory every run, never saved). W1, W2 and W4-ISO: 'no application cache'. OS page cache: uncontrolled, labelled 'process-fresh, page cache uncontrolled'.
global_rules.horizon_criterion: IV6/IV7, computable from the route-cost CSV of a run: for every row, bound = time_s + path_length_m / base_speed_m_per_s, where base_speed_m_per_s is the deck's routing value (W1 1.0; W3, W3b, W1r 1.3 = RouteCostConfig default). The run passes when max(bound) < guard = last FDS frame + output interval (largest frame spacing) AND stderr has no 'Route foresight reaches beyond' (#666) warning. bound is an upper bound of the latest sample time a route decision could read (the first leg is read at the decision time; later legs at their arrival time, each capped at the FDS end). Rows with bound > last FDS frame are 'held-foresight rows': their later legs were priced at the last frame. G0 v2 values: W1 430.6 s vs guard 481.1 s, 0 rows past 480 s, no warning; W3 56.8 s vs 301.2 s; W1r 288.4 s vs 252 s, 812 of 9856 rows (8.2 %) from t = 208 s past 250 s, one warning (logged once per run by design). Margin under 5 s is flagged to the coordinator; the criterion is never relaxed to make a case run.

V_build.reconciliation_D20: D23 wording. The #236 figure (~70 min) and the #241 figure (0.862 s/frame; x 1001 frames is about 14 min, not 70) were measured at pyFDS-Evac 6e70313 with fdsvismap 64d9aa7 and are retired as 'measured at another fdsvismap revision, not reconciled'; the source reading below explains a difference, it is not a measurement at the old revision. #241 is half fixed upstream: fdsvismap 0.3.2 reads the slice once for the required time steps (_get_slice_frame, FDSVisMap.py:621-640) and forms the ray means with np.add.reduceat (:698-720), so the per-call to_global and the per-cell loop of the issue text are gone; still present at 8f7d29a2 are the second _get_visibility_array pass in pyfds_evac/core/visibility.py:541-565 (_vis_metre_array; W3 counters 1806 = 2 x 301 x 3; 0.143 s against compute_all 0.218 s) and the dense bool/float16 storage. #236: the extinction field of fed_incap_co_2000ppm is nearly constant (soot extinction at 1.5 m spans 0.9992793-0.9992923 over 1001 frames, max consecutive change 1.3e-5 /m; preflight/fed_incap_co_2000ppm.json), not bit-identical; an exact dedupe removes nothing there (nor on W3: 300 of 301 distinct) and everything on W3b (1 of 121); a tolerance dedupe is a model change (sight gating decides discovery) and is not measured as an optimisation. V-build measures the second-pass split, storage and the consecutive-frame statistic; it never quotes the issue numbers without this caveat.
